bio: Built by the the Earl of Stainsby in 1850, Horsley Lodge is a charming country retreat in the heart of the Peak District.  Tea can be taken in the "old Restaurant" with its spectacular views of the hills, lakes and the fountain or on the terrace in the summer months.  Featuring gorgeous Vintage china, tableware and themed music, the Champagne Vintage Afternoon Tea experience includes quality teas, fresh baked scones, finger sandwiches, mouth-watering cakes and a glass of champagne each.
